scripts.start:bg: mkdir -p ../../logs && nohup node .output/server/index.mjs >> ../../logs/web.log 2>&1 & echo $! > ../../.web.pid && echo "Web started (PID: $(cat ../../.web.pid)), log: logs/web.log"
scripts.stop: if [ -f ../../.web.pid ] && kill -0 $(cat ../../.web.pid) 2>/dev/null; then kill $(cat ../../.web.pid) && rm -f ../../.web.pid && echo 'Web stopped'; else rm -f ../../.web.pid && echo 'Web not running'; fi
